summary: Iteration 3 — backend retest after sparse-null index fix. All 16/16 tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter2.py now PASS. The critical bug from iter2 (POST /api/auth/register returning 500 on every signup past the first user due to sparse unique index on shopifyCustomerId colliding on explicit null) is fully resolved. Verified end-to-end: (a) 2 fresh registrations with distinct emails both return 200 and set access_token+refresh_token cookies; (b) duplicate email returns 409; (c) dev login returns role=dev and cookies; (d) /api/ui-mode public defaults to waitlist; (e) POST /api/ui-mode unauth→401, non-dev→403, dev→toggles and persists then reverted to waitlist; (f) /api/dev/stats requires dev role; (g) /api/account/subscription returns inactive when no contract; pause without contract returns 404. Index inspection confirms shopifyCustomerId_1 now uses partialFilterExpression={'shopifyCustomerId':{'$type':'string'}}. routes_auth.py no longer inserts shopifyCustomerId:None into user_doc on placeholder Shopify mode. Backend success rate: 100%.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA: previous iter2 failure was caused by `db.users.shopifyCustomerId` index being created with `sparse=True, unique=True`. Sparse indexes still index documents where the field is explicitly set to null — they only skip documents where the field is absent. The register handler always inserted `shopifyCustomerId: None` under placeholder Shopify mode, so every signup past the first one collided on null and Mongo raised E11000 → FastAPI 500. Fix applied across two layers (defence in depth): (1) /app/backend/db.py recreates the index with partialFilterExpression={'shopifyCustomerId':{'$type':'string'}} so only string values are indexed; (2) /app/backend/routes_auth.py no longer inserts the shopifyCustomerId key at all under placeholder Shopify mode — it is only set when a real customer id is returned from the Admin API. The old index was dropped manually before ensure_indexes() recreated it on startup. Verified by curl: register A=200, register B=200, register A again=409.
